## `com.nextfit.ui`

### Formats

**Type:** Class  
**Responsibility:** Turns values into the text the screens show (pesos, dates) and reads what the user types back into numbers.

| Method | Returns | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `days(int days)` | `String` | Writes a number of days with the right singular or plural. |
| `signedPercent(double percent)` | `String` | Writes a change in percent with its sign and a decimal comma, keeping the decimal only when it matters. |
| `money(long pesos)` | `String` | Writes an amount of pesos with a dot between thousands. |
| `date(LocalDate day)` | `String` | Writes a day with the month abbreviated in Spanish. |
| `dateTime(LocalDateTime moment)` | `String` | Writes a day and a time of day. |
| `monthShort(YearMonth month)` | `String` | Writes a month with its abbreviation, to label a chart. |
| `parseMoney(String field, String text)` | `long` | Reads an amount of pesos typed by the user. |
| `parseWholeNumber(String field, String text)` | `int` | Reads a whole number typed by the user. |
| `parseDate(String field, String text)` | `LocalDate` | Reads a day typed as year-month-day. |

| `error(Node owner, NextFitException error)` | `void` | Shows the message of a business error. |
| `labeled(String label, Node field)` | `VBox` | Creates a labeled field row for forms. |

### FxModule

**Type:** Interface  
**Responsibility:** Contract every JavaFX screen implements so the main window can host it in the sidebar.

| Method | Returns | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `id()` | `String` | Returns the stable identifier of the screen, e.g. |
| `title()` | `String` | Returns the text shown in the sidebar (Spanish). |
| `icon()` | `String` | Returns the SVG path of the sidebar icon (see FxIcons). |
| `view()` | `Node` | Returns the screen itself. |
| `onShow()` | `void` | Called every time the user navigates to this screen, to refresh its data. |
| `allowedFor(Role role)` | `boolean` | Tells whether users with the given role may open this screen. |
| `keywords()` | `List<String>` | Extra words that lead to this module in the global search, such as the tabs it contains. |
| `search(String query)` | `List<SearchHit>` | Results this module adds to the global search. |
| `open(String targetId)` | `void` | Opens something inside the module after the user chose one of its search results. |

### FxMotion

**Type:** Class  
**Responsibility:** The small animations of the interface, in one place so every screen moves the same way: cards that rise and fade in one after another, elements that lift when the mouse is over them, menu entries that slide a little and primary buttons that sink when pressed.

### SuggestionSettings

**Type:** Record  
**Responsibility:** The adjustable settings used to build a suggested routine: the highest difficulty allowed, the rest between sets, whether cardio is added every day, how many exercises fit in a day and the extra limits per muscle group.

| Attribute | Type |
|---|---|
| `maxLevel` | `Difficulty` |
| `restSeconds` | `int` |
| `cardioEveryDay` | `boolean` |
| `exercisesPerDay` | `int` |
| `groupCaps` | `Map<MuscleGroup, Difficulty>` |
| `notes` | `List<String>` |

| Method | Returns | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `from(SuggestionRequest request)` | `SuggestionSettings` | Builds the starting settings from the request, before any rule adjusts them. |
| `allows(Exercise exercise)` | `boolean` | Tells whether an exercise can be suggested with these settings. |
| `withMaxLevelAtMost(Difficulty limit)` | `SuggestionSettings` | Lowers the general difficulty limit; a higher limit than the current one is ignored. |
| `withRestAtLeast(int seconds)` | `SuggestionSettings` | Raises the rest between sets; a shorter rest than the current one is ignored. |
| `withCardioEveryDay()` | `SuggestionSettings` | Makes every day include a cardio exercise. |
| `withoutCardioEveryDay()` | `SuggestionSettings` | Removes the cardio exercise that the goal added every day. |
| `withGroupCap(MuscleGroup group, Difficulty limit)` | `SuggestionSettings` | Limits the difficulty for one muscle group; if the group already has a lower limit, that one stays. |
| `withNote(String note)` | `SuggestionSettings` | Adds a warning that explains an adjustment; repeated texts are ignored. |

### ConnectionSource

**Responsibility:** Copies the data of the CSV files to the Oracle database.

| Method | Returns | Description |

| `main(String[] args)` | `void` | Runs the migration from the folder that contains nextfit.properties and the data folder. |

### DataMigration

**Type:** Class  
**Responsibility:** Copies every kind of data from one storage to another (the CSV files to Oracle).

| Attribute | Type |
|---|---|
| `source` | `Storage` |
| `target` | `Storage` |

| Method | Returns | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `run()` | `List<EntityResult>` | Copies everything, in the order the foreign keys need (members before their subscriptions, routines before their assignments, and so on). |
| `count(Storage storage)` | `Map<String, Integer>` | Counts the rows of every kind of data in a storage. |

| Method | Returns | Description |
|---|---|---|

| `toString()` | `String` | Hides the password so it never appears in logs. |

### OracleConnectionCheck

**Type:** Class  
**Responsibility:** Small program that checks the Oracle connection: it prints the connected user or the reason why it failed.

| Method | Returns | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `main(String[] args)` | `void` | Runs the check from the folder that contains nextfit.properties. |

**Type:** Class (implements `ConnectionSource`)  
**Responsibility:** Opens connections to the Oracle database.

| Attribute | Type |
|---|---|
| `config` | `DatabaseConfig` |

| Method | Returns | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `open()` | `Connection` | Opens a new connection. |

### OracleSchemaInstaller

**Type:** Class  
**Responsibility:** Creates the NextFit tables in Oracle by running db/schema.sql with the application user.

| Method | Returns | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `main(String[] args)` | `void` | Runs the schema from the folder that contains nextfit.properties. |

### PooledConnectionSource

**Type:** Class (implements `ConnectionSource`)  
**Responsibility:** Keeps a few connections open and lends them, because opening a connection to a database in the cloud takes a long time and every repository call needs one.

| Attribute | Type |
|---|---|
| `source` | `ConnectionSource` |
| `idle` | `BlockingQueue<Connection>` |
| `permits` | `Semaphore` |

| Method | Returns | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `open()` | `Connection` | Lends a connection: a free one when there is one, a new one otherwise. |

## `com.nextfit.exceptions`

### AiException

**Type:** Class (extends `NextFitException`)  
**Responsibility:** Raised when the artificial intelligence service cannot answer: there is no key, there is no internet, the service refused the request, or its answer could not be read.

### BusinessRuleException

**Type:** Class (extends `NextFitException`)  
**Responsibility:** Thrown when an operation violates a business rule of the gym, such as registering a member who already exists, charging a subscription that is still active, or assigning a routine to a member without an active membership.

### InvalidDataException

**Type:** Class (extends `NextFitException`)  
**Responsibility:** Thrown when an input value does not meet the expected format, range or type, such as a negative weight, a malformed email, or an empty text where content is required.

| Attribute | Type |
|---|---|
| `fieldName` | `String` |

| Method | Returns | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `getFieldName` | - | Getters. |

### NextFitException

**Type:** Abstract class (extends `RuntimeException`)  
**Responsibility:** Abstract root of the NextFit exception hierarchy.

| Attribute | Type |
|---|---|
| `errorCode` | `String` |

| Method | Returns | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `getErrorCode` | - | Getters. |

### PersistenceException

**Type:** Class (extends `NextFitException`)  
**Responsibility:** Thrown when an error occurs while reading from or writing to the system's storage (data files now, database later), such as a corrupted file, denied permission, or a full disk.

### ResourceNotFoundException

**Type:** Class (extends `NextFitException`)  
**Responsibility:** Thrown when a resource (member, trainer, routine, exercise, etc.) is looked up by its identifier and does not exist in the system.
